I am still not sure if Aula is the best book to go with, but it guarantees more than okay quality. Except some minor details and small problems it is okay. But for a logical critique I can say that increasing the usage of other sources than Aula books would be so good. I hope, in future the course will feed the students with more sources. That can be achieved by introducing students to possible sources for deeper Spanish learning, engaging in more activities, but not spending so much time with them in class. So some students can continue if they really think it is beneficial. The course can draw more attention with the introduction of new sources, even if they are used only briefly in class. For language learning most important quality to have is courage and effort, the course can create these more on student by new additions.

Dersteki ödevler çok anlamsız ve gelişimimize katkı sağlamıyor. Video çekmek çok uğraştırıcı ve gereksiz çünkü speaking zaten sınıfta çalışılıyor. Writing taskleri verilse daha iyi olurdu. Ders çok fazla küçük parçalarla puanlara bölünmüş ve yükü çok fazla bu da çok gereksiz.  Hazırlık zaten lise gibi geliyordu, aynı tınıları burada da hissediyoruz. Yine de Ana Hoca sayesinde ders keyifli ve öğreticiydi.
The course is a bit harder than the previous 111 course. I don't mind it, yet, still I believe that little in-class assignments and homework create a time insufficiency.
